subject: Aureus Therapeutics security intake — questionnaire scheduling & sample-log plan

From: Leah Park <leah.park@aureustx.com>

Cc: security@aureustx.com
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SIG intake & CAIQ scheduling + sample log window

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the quick intro via LinkedIn — really appreciate it. Aureus Therapeutics is starting a vendor assessment for Q4 and we'd like to schedule a SIG/CAIQ intake to walk through your questionnaire, evidence expectations, and the timeframe for pulling sample logs.

High-level asks from our side:
- One 45–60 minute intake call to review CAIQ scope and owners.
- Clarify what exact logs (auth, api access, admin ops) you can provide and the format.
- Confirmation on default log retention windows and options for shorter/longer retention for regulated data.

Proposed days/times (PST):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Aug 4, 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00

I've attached our completed CAIQ workbook (Aureus_CAIC_v1.xlsx) with some pre-filled controls to speed things up. Attendees initial list below — I'll confirm by EOD Monday once I sync with our Security Ops.

Attendees (tentative):
- Leah Park, Security Program Manager (leah.park@aureustx.com)
- Sean Yu, Cloud Infra (security@aureustx.com)
- Dr. Kavita Rao, Head of Compliance (kavita.rao@aureustx.com)

Let me know which slot works and any pre-work you want from us.

Thanks,
Leah Park
Security Program Manager | Aureus Therapeutics
leah.park@aureustx.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Aureus_CAIC_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 132KB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@aureustx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-02T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG intake & CAIQ scheduling + sample log window

Hi Leah — thanks for sending this over and for the pre-filled CAIQ. Happy to run the intake. We can cover scope, evidence owners, and the mechanics for delivering logs from our side.

Availability: Tue Aug 3, 14:00–15:00 PST works for our team. Can we confirm that slot?

Pre-call notes / things we'll cover:
- Walkthrough of the CAIQ rows you pre-filled and identify gaps.
- Log types we can provide out-of-the-box (API request logs, auth events, audit trail for admin actions) and exports (JSON/CSV).
- Typical retention defaults (30/90/365 days) and options for custom retention per-account.
- Evidence handoff patterns: secure upload vs. Redox-style signed link; who owns each artifact.
- Timeline for providing sample logs (we generally provide a 2-week window within 3 business days of request; longer retention pulls take more time).

I've attached a short Redwood SIG intake packet and our evidence handoff checklist to help structure the call.

Call attendees from Redwood:
- Mateo Alvarez, Security Solutions (mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai)
- Marissa Cole, Compliance Ops (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) — will own evidence routing
- Ben Carter, Engineering (ben.carter@redwood.ai) — will speak to logs and exports

If that slot works please send a calendar invite and any items you want us to prioritize. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Security Solutions | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0244

Mateo — 14:00–15:00 PST on Tue Aug 3 works. I've put a calendar invite on the way.

Quick clarifications before the call so we can prioritize sections:
1) Retention: our default regime is 7 years for clinical telemetry but for vendor assessments we primarily need to confirm 90-day hot logs + 1 year cold. Can Redwood support a 1-year export, and what is the lead time?
2) Encryption in transit and at rest — is there KMS-based key custody available for dedicated enterprise customers?
3) Do you provide redaction or PII-filtering at export time (we'd prefer pre-filtered samples where possible)?

I'll also attach our attendee list — finalizing internal owners.

Thanks — see you Tue.

Leah Park
Security Program Manager | Aureus Therapeutics

Subject: Re: Request: SIG intake & CAIQ scheduling + sample log window — agenda & actions

Thanks everyone — great call earlier. Notes and next steps below (summarized):

Agenda we covered:
- Intro & scope alignment (CAIQ sections 1–6 prioritized by Aureus)
- Logs we can provide: API access logs, Auth events (success/failure), Admin audit trail, model invocation metadata (token counts, latencies)
- Retention options: default 90-day hot, 365-day cold export available on request; 1-year single-export lead time ~5 business days for standard accounts, 10–15 for high-volume pulls
- Encryption & key custody: hosted customers use Redwood-managed KMS; Dedicated/Private customers can integrate with customer-managed KMS via our KMS bridge (we provided architecture link during call)
- PII filtering: we can apply export-time redaction rules; share your sample redaction policy and we will run a small sample through the pipeline

Action items (owners):
- Aureus: finalize attendee list and mark CAIQ rows that are highest priority (Leah) — due 2027-08-05
- Redwood: provision a sample export window for Aureus (Ben) — provide sample within 3 business days after receipt of priority CAIQ rows
- Redwood: share signed evidence upload link and intake folder (Marissa) — link and instructions shared below
- Redwood/Product: share KMS bridge architecture doc and entitlements matrix (Mateo) — due 2027-08-06

Evidence / links shared: 
- Evidence upload: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/aureus-sig-onboarding (folder created)
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-2027-889
- DocuSign for Data Processing Addendum (DPA): https://docusign.com/s/ABC-789

Attachments provided: sample_logs_instructions.txt (contains steps for generating and encrypting exports)

If anything missing, flag on the Drive folder or reply-all. We'll follow up with the sample in the SLA window.
